attchmntText: Salona Cotspin Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Salona Cotspin Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board meeting held on November 11, 2026. Revenue from operations was Rs. 21,256.85 lakh for the quarter and Rs. 40,917.09 lakh for the half year. Net profit after tax stood at Rs. 262.54 lakh for the quarter and Rs. 488.15 lakh for the half year. Earnings per share were Rs. 4.99 for the quarter and Rs. 9.28 for the half year. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, were Rs. 42,853.31 lakh. The financial results have been reviewed by statutory auditors Gopalaiyer and Subramanian. The information is available on the company website.
